name: skFaktura.sk for WooCommerce
author: skfaktura

sections.description:
skFaktura.sk for WooCommerce connects a WooCommerce store to skFaktura.sk through its API. It can create document drafts or issued documents when an order reaches selected statuses and shows customers a secure link to each created document.

Features include:

  • API connection test for skFaktura.sk.
  • Document creation rules by WooCommerce order status and payment gateway.
  • Manual creation of an invoice draft or a paid invoice from an order.
  • Transfer of line items, shipping, discounts, customer information, and order number.
  • Payment gateway mapping to payment methods in skFaktura.sk.
  • Optional text below document items by payment gateway.
  • Optional supplier details, logo, and stamp for documents created by an individual store.
  • Optional ECB exchange-rate display for documents outside EUR.
  • Secure document links on the order received page and in customer emails.

An skFaktura.sk account with API access and an active WooCommerce installation are required.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP file and activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > skFaktura.sk.
  4. On the Connection tab, enter the API URL and API key created in skFaktura.sk.
  5. Test the connection and configure documents on the remaining tabs.
sections.faq:
Where can I find the API key?

Create it in Settings > API access in skFaktura.sk. API access is available with the Pro plan.

What happens when the plugin is deleted?

WordPress deletes plugin settings, including the stored API key. Documents already created in skFaktura.sk remain available.

Are documents created automatically?

Yes. Enable automatic rules on the Documents tab and assign an action to an order status. You can also create documents manually from an order.
